title: Piggy-in-the-Middle
description: A traybake of reduced-fat pork sausages roasted with red onion, peppers, cherry tomatoes and garlic, finished with butter beans in a balsamic and mustard stock.
ingredients: 3 small red onions, cut into wedges
2 × 400g cans butter beans, drained and rinsed
steps: Tumble onions, peppers, tomatoes, garlic and rosemary into a deep baking tray; spray; stir.
Move vegetables to edges; line sausages in the middle. Prick sausages; dress everything with balsamic vinegar; spray again. Roast 20 minutes.
Dissolve stock cube in boiling water; stir in mixed herbs and mustard.
Remove tray; add butter beans; pour over stock mixture; stir. Turn sausages over; season. Roast another 20 minutes until sausages are browned.
notes: For extra filling power, add halved new potatoes pre-boiled for 15 minutes, added to the tray at the start.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021)
